roles.name: Brewer
roles.description: Each night, if you burn your marshmallow, learn one person loyal to your camp.

roles.name: Wood Chopper
roles.description: Each night, if players were swapped that day, learn how many are loyal to your camp.

roles.name: Firestarter
roles.description: Each night, if you burn your marshmallow, choose a player. Their roast will always succeed tonight.

roles.name: Ranger
roles.description: If you choose to burn three nights in a row, roast five marshmallows the following night.

roles.name: Raccoon
roles.description: Once per game, during the night, you may burn your marshmallow and choose two players: these players swap camps.

roles.name: Sleepwalker
roles.description: Each night, if you burn your marshmallow, choose a player. If they are swapped during the day tomorrow, they lose 2 marshmallows.

roles.name: Water Boy
roles.description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself) from any camp. They are safe from being swapped tomorrow.

roles.name: Firefly Catcher
roles.description: Each night, if you burn your marshmallow, choose two players (not yourself), and learn if any burned tonight.

roles.name: Mosquito
roles.description: If a swap happened the previous day, burn your marshmallow to steal a marshmallow from the other side.

roles.name: Bear Wrangler
roles.description: Once per game, at night, choose a player. If you burn your marshmallow, give them all your marshmallows.

roles.name: Trailblazer
roles.description: Each night, if you burn a marshmallow, choose a player. You learn their role.

roles.name: Night Owl
roles.description: You may open your eyes at night. Once you do this, you can no longer roast.

roles.name: Tent Inspector
roles.description: Each night, learn how many players burned last night.

roles.name: Lanternkeeper
roles.description: Once per game, burn your marshmallow and choose a player in your camp. This player will be your side's swap candidate today regardless of your camp's choice.

roles.name: Echo
roles.description: Once per game, choose to roast one marshmallow for each player on your team. Your teammates will have no abilities until dusk.

roles.name: Storyteller
roles.description: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player. If you burned last night, the Counselor will announce their marshmallow count. If you roasted, learn false information.

roles.name: Stargazer
roles.description: On the fourth day, publicly guess a player of the opposite loyalty's marshmallow count. If you are correct, you steal two of their marshmallows.

roles.name: Poor Sport
roles.description: If you are swapped during the day, everyone burns tonight.
